portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Quantum of the Seas returns to Seattle in 2027 with a week of glaciers, gold rush towns, and sky-high views from North Star.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A sea day to try RipCord by iFLY skydiving, the FlowRider surf simulator, or bumper cars in SeaPlex as the coastline slips by.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage Scenic

portsOfCall.description: Russian and Tlingit heritage meet in Alaska's former capital. Visit Sitka National Historical Park's totem trail, St. Michael's Cathedral, and the Alaska Raptor Center.
portsOfCall.name: Sitka, AK

portsOfCall.description: Gold Rush history and mountain scenery — the White Pass & Yukon Route Railway climbs nearly 3,000 feet in 20 miles.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Morning scenic cruising up a steep-walled fjord to the face of Dawes Glacier — then on to Juneau for the afternoon.
portsOfCall.name: Endicott Arm & Dawes Glacier

portsOfCall.description: Afternoon in Alaska's capital: Mendenhall Glacier, whale watching, or the Mount Roberts Tramway.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Ride North Star 300 feet above the sea for a final look at the Inside Passage.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage

portsOfCall.description: An evening call in British Columbia's garden city — stroll the Inner Harbour, see the Parliament Buildings lit up, or visit Butchart Gardens.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

cabinCategories.description: Interior stateroom — many feature Royal Caribbean's 'virtual balcony', a floor-to-ceiling screen streaming the real-time view outside.
Ocean view stateroom with large window — a cozy vantage point for the Inside Passage.
Ocean view balcony stateroom — Quantum was built with a balcony in most cabins, perfect for fjord days.
Grand Suite with separate living area, large balcony, Coastal Kitchen access, and dedicated suite concierge.

amenityHighlights: North Star observation capsule (300 ft above sea)
inclusions: All meals in the four main dining rooms and Windjammer
Broadway-style shows in the Royal Theater
diningOptions: American Icon, Silk, Grande & Chic main dining rooms
reviewSnippet: Quantum pairs a port-intensive route — Sitka, Skagway, Juneau, and Dawes Glacier — with Royal Caribbean's high-energy onboard thrills. North Star is a standout on scenic days. — Editor's note
